cases.title: Clean hourly data
cases.expected: Train a model that beats the majority baseline with holdout F1 ≥ 0.75, on a time-aware split, within budget.

cases.title: Strong leakage, no contract

input.data: synthetic + `trips` (defines the label) + `member_share`; contract lists nothing

cases.expected: Detect that `trips` leaks the label, exclude it, and still forecast well (F1 ≥ 0.75, but not a too-good-to-be-true ≥ 0.99).

cases.expected: Honor the producer's contract: exclude both declared columns.

cases.title: Weak leakage, no contract (limitation probe)
cases.expected: Exclude `member_share` too. It is derived from the same rides but only weakly separates the classes. Expected to be hard for every system; included to show the limits of automatic detection.
cases.note: Known limitation: needs a contract (C3) or domain knowledge.

checks.name: leakage columns excluded ['member_share']
checks.criterion: fraction of leak columns NOT used as features

cases.title: Invalid target (3 classes)
cases.expected: Reject before any training and say why (this workflow is binary classification). No crash, no wasted runs.

cases.title: Transient training failure
cases.expected: The first training run crashes (worker lost). Retry, and deliver a model of normal quality.

cases.title: Persistent failure of one model family
cases.expected: Random forest always crashes. Stop retrying it after a bounded number of tries, route to another family, and still deliver.

cases.title: Easy target: stop early
cases.expected: The target is easy; stop as soon as it's met (≤ 2 training runs) instead of spending the budget.

cases.title: Unreachable target: search well
cases.expected: The target can't be reached. Use the budget on varied, non-repeated ideas (models, tuning, features), stop at the budget, and still deliver the best model.

cases.title: Real Citi Bike data (from Part 1)
cases.expected: Exclude the contract's leakage columns, split by time, and forecast busy hours with F1 ≥ 0.75, beating the majority baseline.

cases.title: Generality: Titanic (no time column)
cases.expected: Work on a non-time-series dataset: random split, F1 ≥ 0.65, beats majority, within budget.
